info.description:
To support payment gateway needs, we prepare technical documents on the backend-portal.
Where the backend-portal is intended to serve services to OpenAPI and MerchantPortal,
apart from that this service is integrated with Orchestrator, Core Processor
(SNAP Core Processor and Credit Card Processor)
